Slips are rented and the licensee cannot directly transfer their slip to someone else.  Slips are managed by the Harbor and once a slip is released, it is offered based on a paid waitlist.  Some exceptions apply: when a boat is sold and the slip licensee releases the slip, the new owner may occupy the slip for one year before it is offered on the wait list.  Additionally, in the event of a bequest, the family may occupy the slip for 2 years before it is offered to the waitlist.

28 days for recreational vessels. No limit to commercial vessels with current Fish & Wildlife landing receipts.

only 15 days in a calendar month
